When primatologists Zooli and Gil are looking in the rainforest for a silverback gorilla, they're chased into an ancient temple by a robotic silverback that turns out to be a tiny marmoset guarding a sanctuary of mountain gorillas.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E21 — Puddleball!
When rain spoils a game of kickball, Gil invents a new game; Bubble Puppy must overcome his fear of thunder to save the game.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E16 — Triple-Track Train Race!
The Guppies must move fast when a herd of cows wanders onto the train tracks.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E07 — The Moon Rocks!
The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E11 — The Beach Ball!
Molly's friend needs the Guppies' help to finish her work in time to attend the Big Beach Ball.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E20 — Haunted House Party
The Bubble Guppies are invited to a costume party at a haunted house.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E08 — Mountain Ninja Rescue
Ninjas Zooli and Oona are excited about their first mission: escorting snow monkey Moshi up Mt. Danger to join his troop; but it won't be easy: a storm looms, and mischievous Moshi is causing trouble.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E03 — A Royal Mess
Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E26 — Taste Buddies!
When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Spring; Miss Rabbit's Helicopter; Baby Alexander; Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse; Miss Rabbit's Day Off
Grandpa Pig organizes an egg hunt; Miss Rabbit takes Peppa's family for a ride; Peppa's cousin visits; Grandpa Pig takes everyone to visit the lighthouse; Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa Goes to Paris; Grandpa Pig's Pond; Once Upon a Time; Super Potato; Playgroup Star
Peppa and family go on a trip to Paris to meet Delphine Donkey and her family; the Donkey family take Peppa and family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Daddy Pig to face his fear of heights.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Pedro the Cowboy; Peppa & George's Garden; The Flying Vet; International Day; Potato City
Pedro Pony pretends to be a cowboy; Grandpa Pig gives the children seeds for their garden; nearly all the animals need Dr. Hamster's help on the same day; Peppa and her friends dress up; Peppa and her family visit a new theme park.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Ballet Lesson; Grandpa Pig's Boat; Tidying Up; Picnic; Daddy Puts Up a Picture
Peppa is excited about her first ballet lesson; Granny and Grandpa Pig have a little boat; Peppa and George have to clean their bedroom; the family goes on a picnic; Mummy Pig has a new picture.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S14 E02 — Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter
Farmer Al has a new ice resurfacing machine, but when it goes haywire, it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to help; when the Turbots accidentally bring a porcupine to Adventure Bay, the prickly critter gets loose and causes trouble.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E02 — Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race
In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E09 — The Crew Fixes A Blocked Pipe/The Crew Builds A Construction Basketball Show
The pups enlist a kitten named Marble to go inside a pipe and fix the blockage; when a traveling basketball team fails to show up, the construction pups gear up and put on their own basketball show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E10 — Pups Save a Dino Documentary; Pups Save a Grump-A-Saurus
Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary; she and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus on his trail!

title: Deer Squad
description:
S04 E10
Sir Steel is determined for Platinum City to secure a musical award, but a disruptive music ray causes problems; Baron Bite takes control of Dinobot using a Control Collar and amasses an army of snow.

title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
description:
S06 E24 — The Great Pizza Race
It's a head-to-head showdown when Blaze and Crusher enter the great pizza race.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Jet to the Rescue
The Duke of Flappington uses the magical powers of the Princess' gem to raise Barkingburg into the sky; Skye will need to overcome her biggest fears and lead the team.

title: The Marsupilamis
description:
S01 E18 — Party Party
Three energetic Marsupilamis leave their jungle world for the city where mystery and excitement await as they bond with twins eager to protect their extraordinary friends.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E11 — Pups Save a Goldfish; Pups Save a Flying Florist
Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius's new goldfish, Marigold, into the river! When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wingsuits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E05 — The Crew Builds a Car Wash; The Crew Plans Grandpa Day
Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast, so Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race; it's Grandpa Gravel's special day, but when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E25 — Skye's Road Trip Rescue
Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Children's Fete; Fruit; The Aquarium; The Fish Pond; Pedro Is Late
The children organize a party to raise money for a new roof; Miss Rabbit makes fruit smoothies; Peppa takes Goldie to the aquarium; Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fishpond; Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit are stranded on a desert island.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Made Up Musical Instruments; Butterflies; The Botanical Gardens; Viking Day; Mr. Potato's Quiz
The children make instruments from old packaging; Doctor Hamster talks about butterflies; Peppa and George spend a day at the botanical gardens; Peppa and George pretend to be Vikings with Granny; Mr. Potato is a special guest at school.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Sibling School; Patchwork Quilt; New Baby; Baby Names; Holding the Baby
Peppa and George learn how to be the best siblings; Peppa is making a quilt for the baby; on the day of the baby's arrival, Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa's Circus; Night Animals; Pirate Treasure; Garden Games; Going Boating
Peppa and her friends put on a circus; Peppa and George stay up late to hunt for slugs and snails; Pirate Peppa buries a treasure chest; Daddy Pig gives Peppa an old box of garden games; everyone goes boating at the lake.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E09 — Big Truck Pups: Pups Save the Bridge
Ryder and the Pups team up with Al to save Adventure Bay's big bridge from collapsing.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E07 — Pups Save Gustavo's Guitar; Pups Save the Yoga Goats
The pups need to find Gustavo Goodway's missing guitar before the evening's campfire concert; Farmer Yumi's new yoga goat class is a hit, until her goats go missing.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E08 — Jungle Pups: Pups Save a Golden Sweetie; Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Giant Ants
The pups rescue Sweetie when she sneaks into the hidden jungle and finds a mysterious orb, which causes everything she touches to turn to gold; the pups must save a colony of giant ants from destroying the hidden jungle and themselves.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E08 — Pups Save the Hatchlings; Pups Save a Wrongway Farmhand
When Mayor Humdinger decides to make the world's biggest omelet, he accidentally orders the wrong kind of eggs: ones that hatch; traveling Travis volunteers to watch farmer Yumi and farmer Al's farm and characteristically messes up everything.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E22 — Pups Save the Camping Trip; Pups and the Trouble with Turtles
Skye and Rocky go on a camping trip; Baby turtles start popping up all over town; Ryder and the pups must return baby turtles to their pond.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E07 — Pups Save Apollo; Pups Save the Hippos
The pups must invade the Spider King's lair to rescue Apollo; Ryder and the others must rebuild a trapeze before a show.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E05 — Pups Save a Waiter-Bot; Pups Stop a Pie-Clone
Mr. Porter's new high-tech waiter robot helps around the café, but it can't stop cleaning; it's up to the pups to clean up the mess; Mayor Humdinger creates a cyclone of delicious pies, and the pups must stop it before the town is covered.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E23 — Rescue Wheels: Pups Save Adventure Bay
Two competitive truckers come to town for a monster truck rally, one of them befriends the pups, the other stirs up lots of trouble.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E03 — The Crew Builds a Mini Golf Course; The Crew Builds a Butterfly Garden
When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble and Crew use their construction skills to build a new sport, Bunny Ball; after the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E22 — The Crew Fixes the Talent Show Stage; The Crew Builds Instruments
When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town talent show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day; Sierra Sparkle comes to sing for Builder Cove Day, but when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E08 — Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-Dino
Mayor Humdinger and his Kitties go to Dino Wilds for Dino acting lessons but somehow find themselves bound for Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E11 — Pups Stop the Falling Space Junk; Pups Stop the Giant Cuckoo
When Digi and Tal's space vacuum breaks, it's up to the pups to save Mayor Humdinger from falling space debris; Humdinger's cuckoo clock goes out of control; Ryder and the Pups must rescue Travis and get control of the cuckoo to save Humdinger.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E06 — Big Truck Pups Stop a Flood
The PAW Patrol uses its new big trucks and the help of new pup pal Al to repair a dam before Adventure Bay is flooded.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E03 — Pups Save a Rubble-Double; Pups Save a Clown
Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E24 — Pups Save a Pluck-O-Matic; Pups Save a Mascot
Yumi's new Robo-Corn Plucker goes haywire; Ryder and the "PAW Patrol" must get it under control; Daring Danny X, dressed as a "Bird X" mascot, gets carried away by a couple of eagles.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E21 — Pups Save a Bat; Pups Save a Toof
A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell so Mayor Goodway can't ring it; Chase and the pups show Alex how fear of the dentist can be conquered.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E04 — Build Me a Building!
The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E17 — Don't Yuck My Yum!
In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E17 — Happy Clam Day!
The Bubble Guppies have to learn about the mail so they can send invitations to a party for Clam.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E14 — Boy Meets Squirrel
The Bubble Guppies learn about trees.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E18 — Swimtastic Check-Up!
The Mayor gets a tummy ache while training for Bubbletucky's annual marathon and has to go to the hospital to get checked out.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E06 — Grumpfish Special
The Bubble Guppies must deal with a difficult customer at their restaurant.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E08 — The New Year's Dragon!
The Guppies are excited for China's Lunar New Year Festival, where they will operate a giant festival dragon in the grand parade.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E13 — Construction Psyched!
Goby must retrace his steps to find his lost toy at a construction site.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E21 — A Load of Litterbugs!
On the U.S.S. Recycler, Captain Deema and her crew strive to leave every planet cleaner than they found it; however, their mission is put to the test when a crew of messy Litterbugs, led by the evil Garbage Khan, take over their ship.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E04 — The Good, the Sad, and the Grumpy!
When Mr. Grumpfish turns up in Happy Junction, he makes everyone in town really grumpy; Sheriff Molly must find a way to help everyone handle their tricky emotions.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E08 — A Furry Tale!
Hansel and Gretel have to get Bubble Puppy and Bubble Kitty home safe to the Furry Godmother, but they're being stalked by a witch.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E14 — The Big Rig Bandit!
When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E09 — We Totally Rock!
The Bubble Guppies take the stage and learn about rock music.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Eye Test; Grandad Dog's Garage; Foggy Day; Jumble Sale; Swimming
Peppa's friend wears glasses; Peppa's car runs out of petrol; Peppa and George play at the playground; Peppa's play group holds a jumble sale; Peppa's family goes to the pool.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Paper Games; Grandpa's Robot; Granny Sheep Moves In; Cardboard Boxes
Madame Gazelle teaches the children paper games; Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house; Peppa plays at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in; Peppa is at Suzy's house and takes the cardboard outside.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Parachute Jump; Miss Rabbit's Taxi; Playing Pretend; Scooters; George's Racing Car
The school roof is leaking, so Mummy Pig does a parachute jump to raise money to fix it; Miss Rabbit spends the day picking people up and dropping people off in her job as taxi driver.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Nursery Rhymes; Digger World; The Doll Hospital; Wendy Wolf's Birthday; Princess Peppa
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup share their best nursery rhymes; Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World, where they build walls and knock them over again.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E05 — Pups Save the Dino Chicken
The PAW Patrol team and Mayor Goodway travel to Dino Island for a tour led by Rex; during the visit, the group discovers that Timmy the Tyrannosaurus rex fears Mayor Goodway's pet chicken, Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E11 — Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit; Pups Put a Mouse on the Move
After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a safety suit for him to wear, designed to protect him from danger; Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the competition, so he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E02 — The Crew Builds Sierra Sparkle's Bedroom; The Crew Builds A Water Ski Jump
Rubble and crew has a sleepover with Sierra Sparkle, but while surprising Sierra with a bedroom renovation, her favorite stuffy goes missing; when Mayor Greatway hurts her foot, the pups construct a special chair to help her do a huge waterski stunt.
